comment: Directory of bake-offs. Add one line per bake-off; the slug must match its folder name.

bakeoffs.title: Heat capacity model
bakeoffs.blurb: Fit the heat capacity C(T) from ten measurements, then predict outside the range you fitted on.

bakeoffs.title: Student final grade
bakeoffs.blurb: Predict a student's final maths grade from 30 features of school records and a survey, with a model of your own design.

bakeoffs.title: Sentiment of a review
bakeoffs.blurb: Tell whether a sentence from an Amazon, IMDB or Yelp review is positive or negative, starting from the naive Bayes spam classifier.
